title: Infrastructure · Thulu
heading: Infrastructure
subtitle: The machine Thulu runs on: how busy it is, what is using it and how much room is left. Only the operator sees this page.

live.paused: Paused while the tab is hidden
live.stale: Couldn't refresh. Showing data from {ago} ago.

blocked.not_operator_title: Only the operator sees this page
blocked.not_operator: Only admins of the operator workspace ({env}) can see the infrastructure. It shows every workspace on this install, so workspace owners get the usage page instead.
blocked.forbidden_title: Your role can't open this page
blocked.forbidden: Ask an admin of the operator workspace to look, or to change your role.
blocked.unavailable: This daemon started without its infrastructure inspector. Restart it, or look in its logs for the line that says why the inspector didn't start.
blocked.failed: The daemon answered: {error}. Check that it is running, then try again.

problems.title: Some sources couldn't be read, so the numbers below leave them out.

activity.title: Activity
activity.note: Sampled every 15 seconds and kept in memory, so a daemon restart starts the history over.

young.one: Showing the last minute, since the daemon started.
young.other: Showing the last {count} minutes, since the daemon started.

charts.warming_up: Collecting samples. The first points show up within a minute.
charts.no_proc: Needs a readable /proc on the host. The Machine tab says how to mount one.
charts.net_container: The daemon container's own network; mount the host's /proc to see the machine's.

usage.title: What's using it
usage.empty: Agents, sandboxes and chats show up here while they run.
usage.other_note: Containers on this engine that Thulu didn't start
usage.other_install_note: Containers another Thulu install on this engine started

capacity.title: Capacity

room.one: {count} run waits for room in its workspace quota
room.other: {count} runs wait for room in their workspace quota

capacity.sandboxes_link: See which sandboxes hold a slot, and the queue
capacity.queue_minutes: Longest wait in the agent queue (minutes)
capacity.install_wide: Capacity limits apply to every workspace on this install.

errors.integer: It must be a whole number

containers.title: Containers
containers.empty: Change the search or the kind, or include stopped containers.
containers.none: Agents, sandboxes and chats start containers here when tasks run.
containers.stop_chat: The conversation goes on: the next message starts a new container and resumes the session.
containers.stop_agent: The run is recorded as stopped by you. The task stays in its stage and can be relaunched.
containers.orphan_hint: No run of its task launched this agent container: the run was deleted, the task is gone, or a restart left it behind.
containers.remove_orphan_message: No run of the task depends on this container. It is deleted, not stopped, so nothing reads it later as a run that finished.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.empty: A workspace shows up here once it has a record in the database, a running container or a run today.

quotas.title: Workspace quotas
quotas.empty: No workspace namespace has a ResourceQuota.
quotas.docker_note: Per-workspace quotas (CPU, memory and pods) exist only on Kubernetes. On Docker the workspaces share the machine; the Capacity limits apply to the whole install.

disks.title: Disks
disks.note_container: The daemon reads disks from inside its container, so a filesystem it doesn't mount isn't listed. Mount it into the container and add its path to {env}.

storage.title: Data directory
storage.empty: Nothing stored yet. Projects, worktrees, attachments and logs land here as tasks run.
storage.partial: Some folders couldn't be read, so the total is low.
storage.pending: Measuring. This runs every few minutes.
storage.no_data_dir: This daemon has no data directory to measure.

host.title: Host
host.about_q: Where do these numbers come from?
host.note_container: The daemon runs inside a container, so these numbers come from the host /proc it can see. Under Docker Desktop or Colima that is the VM, not your computer.
host.note_no_proc: The daemon can't read /proc here (macOS, or a locked-down container), so host CPU, memory and network are missing. Mount the host's /proc into the container and point {env} at it.

runtime.title: Runtime
runtime.none_note: The daemon reaches neither Docker nor Kubernetes, so there are no containers to show.
runtime.agent_image_pending: Checking the registry for {base} with Claude Code installed
runtime.agent_image_building: Building {image} (Job {job}); pods install Claude Code on first use until it is ready
runtime.agent_image_failed: Build failed, pods install Claude Code on first use: {message}
runtime.no_metrics: metrics-server isn't installed or isn't answering, so pod and node usage is missing. Requests and limits still show. Install metrics-server (k3s ships it) to fill CPU and memory in.
runtime.no_nodes: The daemon can't list nodes. Grant it get and list on nodes in its ClusterRole.

cache.title: Dependency cache
cache.hint: How sandbox installs went: what came from the cache and what was downloaded again.
cache.note: Kept for 90 days and refreshed every minute, apart from the host charts.
cache.partial: The install log starts on {date}, so earlier days are empty.
cache.empty: This fills in as tasks install dependencies in their sandbox and projects prewarm their cache.
cache.unavailable_title: No install log on this daemon
cache.unavailable: This daemon has no sandbox store, so there is no install log to show.
cache.failed: The daemon answered: {error}. It tries again in a minute.

tiles.hit_rate_sub: {hits} of {runs} installs with a setup phase
tiles.time_saved_none: No full install to compare with yet

projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: No project ran a setup phase in this range.
projects.prewarm_started: Prewarm started; the table updates within a minute

workspaces.title: Cache per workspace
workspaces.empty: No measurement yet. The first one comes after a prewarm or a task's install.

tools.title: mise versions
tools.empty: No cache holds a mise version.
